judge: the build agent (Claude, the LLM that built ditto), not a human; judged on 2026-10-27 from the schema proposals and the extracted values
task: v0.4 gate: schema precision of unprompted mode = entity fields / all proposed fields, on 10 SWDE development sites; gate >= 0.8
site_rule: the alphabetically-first development site of each of the 8 verticals, plus the second development site of the two alphabetically-first verticals (auto, book)

criterion.entity: a value someone scraping this page type would want as a database column: an attribute of the page's main entity (identity, description, specifications, prices, offers and availability, images of it, ratings and reviews of it, identifiers, links that identify a linked entity such as an author, seller or employer profile, or that lead to the entity's own resources such as its website or application form)
criterion.noise: site chrome and navigation (tab links, links to search or listing pages), related or recommended items, counters, the page's own timestamps, share buttons, decorative logos, promotional widgets, a field that duplicates another field of the same template, or a field whose extracted values are mostly not what it claims
criterion.unit: one proposed field of one template's schema_proposal.json (all fields judged)
